scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof uses hub-link reduction, a collapsible invariant subcomplex, the integral relative exterior chain complex and simply connected CW homotopy theory. Finite exact tests corroborate, not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Spider trees with \(k\ge3\), each arm length at least two, at least one length at least three, and \(r\ge\max_i\ell_i\). The smaller-\(r\) regime, arbitrary trees, equivariant homotopy splittings and integral quotient torsion are not covered. Independent mathematical review has not been performed.
title: Length-profile invariance and integral symmetry in higher independence complexes of spider trees
